title: Kitchen and entrance, Istanbul apartment
description: A lived-in galley kitchen of an Istanbul apartment, about 2.5 x 4 m, opening onto the narrow entrance hallway to the front door. White glossy lower cabinets, a grey stone-look worktop, white square wall tiles, a small white PVC window with a short tulle curtain at the far end, a gas hob with a kettle and a double teapot (caydanlik), a dish rack by the sink. Light grey floor tiles.

objects.boiler: a white wall-hung gas combi boiler mounted on the kitchen wall above the worktop, with copper pipes and a yellow gas pipe running down from it
objects.glass_cabinets: a row of upper wall cabinets with framed glass doors and no latches, showing stacked plates and drinking glasses inside
objects.microwave: a microwave oven sitting loose on top of a tall white fridge-freezer, near its front edge
objects.jar_shelf: an open wooden wall shelf above the worktop holding a row of large glass jars filled with lentils, rice and pasta
objects.shoe_cabinet: in the entrance hallway beside the front door, a tall shoe cabinet with a coat rack, plus three stacked cardboard moving boxes on the floor that narrow the path to the front door to about half its width
objects.bottle_rack: a water bottle rack with a visible strap holding a large water jug in place
objects.front_door: the grey steel apartment front door at the end of the short entrance hallway
